prompt: In the style of a photorealistic photo, a sterile hospital corridor stretches into the distance with polished linoleum floors reflecting overhead fluorescent lights. On the left side of the frame, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a hard plastic chair, her posture slumped forward in exhaustion. Next to her stands a young nurse in blue scrubs, holding a digital tablet securely against her chest while looking down at the seated patient with gentle concern. In the center of the hallway, a tall man in a grey suit paces back and forth, his hands deep in his pockets as he checks a silver wristwatch repeatedly. To the right, a small boy in a yellow raincoat clutches a worn teddy bear tightly, standing perfectly still beside a large potted fern that adds a touch of green to the clinical environment. Further down the hall on the right, a doctor in a white coat points firmly toward a closed door, directing the attention of a worried father in a denim jacket who stands opposite him. The father nods slightly, his eyes fixed on the indicated entrance. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. The air appears still and quiet despite the visible tension among the figures. The lighting is cool and even, highlighting the clean surfaces and the distinct expressions of worry and patience on the faces of those present. Every detail, from the creases in the suits to the texture of the teddy bear’s fur, is rendered with sharp clarity and realistic depth.
